items.Tainted Rounds: Third: cuts healing and adds damage on every split projectile.

metaBuilds.holes: Little ability haste after Solaris, so fewer Gunslinger triggers in long fights.

metaBuilds.synergy: Solaris turns each ability into a big empowered shot, Vanquisher executes, and Imperator multiplies the crits from Vaporize into Gunslinger shots.

items.Solaris: First: ability then basic attack for a big, healing hit.
items.Vanquisher: Second: crit and an execute after a Vaporize volley.
items.Imperator: Third: crits hit harder for a bigger Ventilate and Gunslinger shot.

metaBuilds.holes: All-in on crit damage; against heavy armor without penetration, the combo falls flat.

optimizer.synergy: LUNARI 4.0 fires two projectiles that both carry on-hit effects, so Sky Splitter's health chunks and Viper and Deathstalker armor shred stack twice as fast.

items.Sky Splitter: First: both projectiles chunk current health, and Vaporize spreads it.
items.Viper: Second: armor shred stacks fast from double projectiles, plus ability damage.
items.Deathstalker: Third: more shred per hit and bonus attack speed for Ventilate.
items.Plasma Blade: Fourth: attack speed and stacking crit chance on every shot.
items.Imperator: Fifth: crits hit harder on Ventilate and Gunslinger shots.
items.Tainted Rounds: Last: cuts healing and hits harder as targets drop low.

swaps.gain: Attack speed and current-health chunks on both projectiles, much stronger against tanks.
swaps.lose: Solaris' empowered healing shot after each ability and its haste for Gunslinger.

optimizer.holes: No defense in six items: if Rocket Dash is down when a diver arrives, TwinBlast dies.

optimizer.synergy: Hemophagia strikes faster with attack speed, so Orion turns haste into attack speed, while Tainted Scepter and Magnify add damage and healing to Arterial Grip and Exsanguinate.

items.Orion: First: haste becomes attack speed for faster Hemophagia strikes.
items.Tainted Scepter: Second: cuts healing and adds damage on every ability hit.
items.Wraith Leggings: Third: penetration and bonus damage for Arterial Grip and Bloodbound.
items.Magnify: Fourth: magical armor shred plus healing on top of Exsanguinate.
items.Spirit Of Amir: Fifth: power and some health while channeling Arterial Grip.
items.Oblivion Crown: Last: multiplies power behind Lilith's strikes and Exsanguinate.

optimizer.holes: Arterial Grip breaks the moment Valmont is crowd-controlled, and this build has no tenacity or armor to stop that.

metaBuilds.synergy: Prophecy's attack speed powers Hemophagia, so Lilith strikes harder with each Crimson Sigil hit, Entropy adds ticks to Rupture blades, and Dreambinder slows Arterial Grip targets.

items.Entropy: First: each Rupture blade and Bloodbound hit gets an extra damage tick.
items.Prophecy: Second: attack speed and magic hits, so Lilith strikes harder through Hemophagia.
items.Dreambinder: Third: abilities slow, keeping Arterial Grip targets close, plus health.

metaBuilds.holes: Low defense for an offlaner; a lane bully punishes Valmont before Exsanguinate heals him back.

metaBuilds.synergy: Azure Core shields Valmont in trades, Entropy adds a tick to each Rupture blade, and Overseer heals him from every hit on heroes.

items.Azure Core: First: a shield in trades and power that grows from camp leaders.
items.Entropy: Second: extra damage ticks on Rupture blades and Bloodbound.
items.Overseer: Third: more damage, and hero hits heal Valmont alongside Exsanguinate.

metaBuilds.holes: No attack speed, so Hemophagia and Lilith strike far less often than Valmont's passive wants.

optimizer.synergy: Orion turns item haste into attack speed for Hemophagia, then power and magic armor shred grow Arterial Grip, Rupture and Exsanguinate, finished by Oblivion Crown.

items.Orion: First: haste becomes attack speed, so Lilith strikes more through Hemophagia.
items.Tainted Scepter: Second: cuts healing on targets held by Arterial Grip, plus health.
items.Wraith Leggings: Third: abilities deal bonus magic damage, and speed to stay in range.
items.Magnify: Fourth: Rupture blades stack magic armor shred, plus healing from damage.
items.Spirit Of Amir: Fifth: more power in lane, healing while clearing camps.
items.Oblivion Crown: Last: multiplies power for bigger Arterial Grip and Exsanguinate.

swaps.gain: Attack speed from haste so Lilith strikes more often, plus rising damage on one target.
swaps.lose: Azure Core's shield in trades and its extra mana, so Valmont trades less safely early.

optimizer.holes: Almost no defense: Valmont relies on Exsanguinate to heal, and if it misses he cannot hold the offlane.

optimizer.synergy: Surprise, Surprise!'s passive penetration stacks with Deathstalker and Viper shred, so Knock, Knock! and basic attacks hit hard, and Necrosis shortens Back It Up! for picks.

items.Deathstalker: First: attack speed and armor shred on top of your passive penetration.
items.Viper: Second: on-hit and ability damage boost for Knock, Knock!
items.Plasma Blade: Third: crit chance and attack speed for sustained trades.
items.Imperator: Fourth: bigger crits once crit chance is stacked.
items.Vanquisher: Fifth: executes low targets that Back It Up! drags back.
items.Necrosis: Last: shorter Back It Up! cooldown for more picks.

optimizer.holes: Necrosis boosts ultimate damage, but Back It Up! is a teleport, so half of the last item does nothing for Wraith.

optimizer.synergy: Peekaboo! marks targets so Knock, Knock! hits for bonus damage with a shorter cooldown, and Viper's ability-damage boost plus shred make that poke combo hurt from range.

items.Deathstalker: First: armor shred stacking with your passive penetration for mid trades.
items.Viper: Second: boosts Knock, Knock! and Peekaboo! damage on marked targets.
items.Plasma Blade: Third: crit and attack speed for basic attacks between pokes.
items.Imperator: Fourth: bigger crits once crit chance is stacked.
items.Vanquisher: Fifth: executes targets poked low by Knock, Knock!
items.Necrosis: Last: shorter Back It Up! cooldown for repeat picks.

optimizer.holes: Knock, Knock!'s marked bonus scales with magical power, which this build barely has outside Plasma Blade.

metaBuilds.synergy: Wraith's abilities also scale with power, so Soulbinder rewards long Knock, Knock! snipes, Noxia adds a max-health chunk on the follow-up shot, and Wraith Leggings boosts each hit.

items.Soulbinder: First: power and haste; long-range Knock, Knock! snipes deal bonus damage.
items.Noxia: Second: Peekaboo! then Knock, Knock! for a max-health chunk.
items.Wraith Leggings: Third: abilities deal bonus magic damage, plus speed to reposition.

metaBuilds.holes: No tankiness on a support: once Surprise, Surprise! is down, any dive kills Wraith.

metaBuilds.synergy: Alternator and Vanquisher give penetration that stacks with Surprise, Surprise!'s passive, so Peekaboo! into Knock, Knock! hits hard, and Infernum ignites marked targets.

items.Alternator: First: penetration and haste; casting each ability builds its bonus stacks.
items.Vanquisher: Second: crit and an execute for Knock, Knock! on low targets.
items.Infernum: Third: repeated hits ignite targets for a slice of max health.

metaBuilds.holes: Pure damage support: Wraith steals lane gold and gives the carry no protection if the snipe misses.

optimizer.synergy: A full tank shell: heavy armor and health let Wraith stand in front, and Back It Up! still drags divers back without needing damage.

items.Stonewall: First: heavy armor against physical laners poking the support.
items.Forticus: Second: armor, shorter stuns and a shield when caught.
items.Raiment of Renewal: Third: huge health and missing-health regen between trades.
items.Catalytic Drive: Fourth: magic armor and a basic attack that heals and hits nearby enemies.
items.Vainglory: Fifth: both armors grow the longer Wraith stays in a fight.
items.Unbroken Will: Last: shorter stuns and an armor burst when focused.

optimizer.holes: No power at all, so Knock, Knock! and Peekaboo! barely hurt; Wraith's sniper kit is wasted on full tank.

items.The Perforator: First: ignores armor and slows so High Impact slams land.
items.Spear Of Desolation: Second: faster stance swaps and a damage boost after casting.
items.Painweaver: Third: stacking penetration and speed while you chain abilities.
items.Basilisk: Fourth: armor shred and health for long fights with clones.
items.Alternator: Fifth: boosts Windsurge/Force Push, your alternate ability.
items.Mutilator: Last: max-health damage and healing across your ability chain.

optimizer.holes: With no attack speed and little health, Wukong spawns clones slowly and loses extended fights against bruisers.

items.The Perforator: First: ignore armor and slow targets hit by Windsurge or Force Push.
items.Spear Of Desolation: Second: ultimate haste for more stance swaps, plus a damage window.
items.Painweaver: Third: each hit stacks penetration and speed while chasing with Pole Vault.
items.Basilisk: Fourth: health, haste and armor shred from repeated staff hits.
items.Alternator: Fifth: casting each ability builds bonus stacks; alternate casts hit harder.
items.Mutilator: Last: abilities chunk max health and heal Wukong through long fights.

optimizer.holes: Little tankiness beyond Basilisk; Wukong relies on Cyclebreaker's damage reduction, and if it is down he gets burst.

metaBuilds.synergy: Storm Breaker chains lightning off empowered basics for jungle clear, Sky Splitter adds current-health damage, and Tainted Rounds stacks with Rising Storm attack speed.

items.Storm Breaker: First: chaining lightning basics clear camps and apply on-hit effects.
items.Sky Splitter: Second: current-health damage and lifesteal on every Silksong hit.
items.Tainted Rounds: Third: anti-heal and on-hit damage that grows on low targets.

metaBuilds.holes: Melee on-hit with no defense, so Yin melts if she cannot reach targets after Lash Kick.

optimizer.synergy: Mutilator procs on Lash Kick, Backlash and Windburn for max-health damage, while The Perforator, Spear Of Desolation, Painweaver, Basilisk and Alternator stack armor penetration and haste.

items.Mutilator: First: each ability deals max-health damage, and omnivamp heals clears.
items.The Perforator: Second: ignores armor and slows targets pulled by Lash Kick.
items.Spear Of Desolation: Third: ultimate haste for more Quelling Gale and a damage boost.
items.Painweaver: Stacking penetration and speed to chase after Lash Kick.
items.Basilisk: Armor shred, health and speed for extended fights.
items.Alternator: Last: Backlash, her alternate ability, deals more damage.

swaps.gain: Mutilator turns every Lash Kick, Backlash and Windburn into max-health damage for far more rotation damage.
swaps.lose: Dropping Storm Breaker loses its attack speed and the chaining lightning that speeds up jungle clears.

optimizer.holes: Ability-focused damage ignores Yin's Rising Storm attack speed, so long auto fights favor the on-hit build.

metaBuilds.synergy: Storm Breaker and Sky Splitter speed up Silksong hits to stack Rising Storm and Windburn's third-hit chunk, while Tainted Rounds cuts healing and finishes low targets.

items.Storm Breaker: First: fast hits charge a chain lightning bolt, great for wave clear.
items.Sky Splitter: Second: current-health chunks and lifesteal on every Silksong hit.
items.Tainted Rounds: Third: cuts healing and hits harder as targets drop low.

metaBuilds.holes: Needs long auto-attack trades; a ranged offlaner who kites Yin keeps her from stacking Rising Storm.

optimizer.synergy: An ability build: Mutilator chunks max health with Lash Kick, Backlash and Windburn, penetration cuts armor, and Spear Of Desolation brings Quelling Gale back faster.

items.Mutilator: First: abilities chunk max health and heal Yin in lane trades.
items.The Perforator: Second: ignore armor and slow targets after Lash Kick.
items.Spear Of Desolation: Third: ultimate haste for more Quelling Gale, plus a damage window.
items.Painweaver: Fourth: each hit stacks penetration and speed for chasing.
items.Basilisk: Fifth: health, haste and armor shred against tanky offlaners.
items.Alternator: Last: casting each ability builds bonus stacks for more damage.

swaps.gain: Max-health chunks on every ability and healing, so Lash Kick and Backlash hit tanks hard.
swaps.lose: Storm Breaker's attack speed and chain lightning that clears waves.

optimizer.holes: Drops attack speed, so Rising Storm and Windburn's third hit come slower in long trades.

optimizer.synergy: Whispering Echoes applies Soul Rip that resets Severance, so Alternator boosts that opener first, and haste keeps the Echoes, Severance, Anima Burst loop cycling.

items.Alternator: First: Whispering Echoes is your alternate ability, so it hits harder.
items.Basilisk: Second: armor shred from bouncing basic attacks, plus health.
items.Spear Of Desolation: Third: faster Soulstorm and a damage boost after casting.
items.The Perforator: Fourth: ignores armor and slows so Severance dashes connect.
items.Mutilator: Fifth: max-health damage and healing on top of Anima Burst.
items.Painweaver: Last: stacking penetration and speed while chaining abilities.

optimizer.holes: Yurei rushes in with Severance, and with only Basilisk's health she dies once Soul Rip resets stop coming.

metaBuilds.synergy: Every ability triggers Hallowed Strikes' ranged attacks, so Solaris empowers the next one, Mindrazor splashes it around the target, and Infernum ignites enemies hit repeatedly.

items.Mindrazor: Second: basic hits splash damage around the target after Anima Burst.
items.Infernum: Third: repeated hits from Whispering Echoes ignite for max-health damage.

metaBuilds.holes: No defense; if Severance does not reset, Yurei is stuck in melee range with nothing to survive.

optimizer.synergy: Penetration stacks so Severance and Anima Burst cut armor, Spear Of Desolation brings Soulstorm back faster, and Mutilator turns each ability into a max-health chunk.

items.Alternator: First: penetration and haste; cycling abilities builds bonus damage stacks.
items.Basilisk: Second: health, haste and armor shred from repeated Kokoroken hits.
items.Spear Of Desolation: Third: ultimate haste for more Soulstorm, plus a damage window.
items.The Perforator: Fourth: ignore armor and slow targets Severance passes through.
items.Mutilator: Fifth: abilities chunk max health and heal Yurei.
items.Painweaver: Last: each hit stacks penetration and speed for chasing.

optimizer.holes: Only Basilisk adds health; against a lane that out-trades her, Yurei has no defense to fall back on.

metaBuilds.synergy: Augmentation empowers the basic attack after each ability, Mutilator chunks max health with Spear of Nyr and Barricade, and Basilisk shreds armor as Gladiator stacks.

items.Augmentation: First: attack speed, health and an empowered hit after each ability.
items.Mutilator: Second: abilities chunk max health and heal Zarus in trades.
items.Basilisk: Third: health, haste and armor shred inside Coliseum.

metaBuilds.holes: Light on defense; if Coliseum's target escapes, Zarus is left in the middle of their team.

optimizer.synergy: Penetration stacks so Spear of Nyr and Barricade swings cut through armor, Spear Of Desolation brings Coliseum back faster, and Earthshaker ramps ability damage.

items.Alternator: First: penetration and haste; cycling abilities builds bonus damage stacks.
items.The Perforator: Second: ignore armor and slow targets hit by Spear of Nyr.
items.Spear Of Desolation: Third: ultimate haste for more Coliseum, plus a damage window.
items.Painweaver: Fourth: each hit stacks penetration and speed while chasing.
items.Earthshaker: Fifth: melee hits ramp ability damage, plus health.
items.Basilisk: Last: health, haste and armor shred for long fights.

swaps.gain: Penetration that makes Spear of Nyr and Barricade swings hit harder through armor.
swaps.lose: Augmentation's health, attack speed and empowered basic attack after each ability.

optimizer.holes: Barely any health until late; Zarus must win fast inside Coliseum or he dies.

optimizer.synergy: Alternator boosts Spear of Nyr for camps and gank pokes, and Earthshaker's melee stacks build quickly from basic attacks to boost Barricade swings and Coliseum.

items.Alternator: First: harder Spear of Nyr for clears and gank openers.
items.The Perforator: Second: ignores armor and slows targets before Coliseum.
items.Spear Of Desolation: Third: more Coliseum casts and a damage boost after casting.
items.Painweaver: Fourth: stacking penetration and speed for chasing between lanes.
items.Earthshaker: Fifth: melee builds stacks fast, boosting Barricade swings and spear damage.
items.Basilisk: Last: armor shred and health for objective fights.

optimizer.holes: Spear of Nyr deals reduced damage to monsters, so an Alternator start speeds clears less than it looks.

optimizer.synergy: Refibrillator's damage over time and Ricochet bounces charge Lifecore and Lunaria fast, and their heal power stacks with Infuse and Triage Protocol's boosted healing.

items.Lifecore: First: basic-attack damage charges wisps; heal power boosts Infuse.
items.Lunaria: Second: more heal power and stored damage that heals the weakest ally.
items.Oblivion Crown: Third: multiplies power behind Infuse and the Neural Regenesis revive.
items.Spirit Of Amir: Fourth: power and some health for staying in Infuse range.
items.Timewarp: Fifth: shorter Infuse and Ricochet cooldowns plus mana regen.
items.Windcaller: Last: shares speed with allies for chases and escapes.

optimizer.holes: Zinx has no escape, and with no defensive items a single dive on her stops the healing.

metaBuilds.synergy: Prophecy, Spectra and Orion pile on attack speed so Refibrillator hits stack Triage Protocol fast, while haste brings Ricochet and Bad Medicine back sooner.

items.Prophecy: First: magic damage on each hit, plus attack speed and haste.
items.Spectra: Second: huge attack speed to reach full Triage Protocol stacks quickly.
items.Orion: Third: haste becomes attack speed, and damage builds on one target.

metaBuilds.holes: No defense; a diving offlaner kills Zinx before Neural Regenesis can bring her back.

optimizer.synergy: Combustion splashes every Ricochet bounce and Bad Medicine hit, Noxia chunks max health on the second ability, and Oblivion Crown multiplies power.

items.Combustion: First: each ability splashes extra damage on nearby enemies.
items.Noxia: Second: Ricochet then Bad Medicine for a max-health chunk.
items.Oblivion Crown: Third: multiplies power for bigger Ricochet and Infuse.
items.Crescelia: Fourth: empowered basic after each ability, plus gold for hitting heroes.
items.Timewarp: Fifth: each cast trims other cooldowns, so Ricochet stuns come back sooner.
items.Wraith Leggings: Last: abilities deal bonus magic damage, plus movement speed.

swaps.gain: Splash damage on every ability, so Ricochet and Bad Medicine hit much harder.
swaps.lose: Prophecy's attack speed and magic damage on each Refibrillator hit.

optimizer.holes: Six damage items and no defense: Zinx relies on Neural Regenesis, and once it is used she is very easy to kill.

metaBuilds.synergy: Prophecy and Orion turn Refibrillator into rapid magical on-hit fire stacking Triage Protocol, and Spectra adds missing-health true damage after three hits.

items.Prophecy: First: magical on-hit damage on every Refibrillator shot.
items.Orion: Second: haste becomes attack speed for faster Triage Protocol stacks.
items.Spectra: Third: on-hit stacks trigger bonus damage that grows on low targets.

metaBuilds.holes: Auto-attack Zinx gives up Ricochet and Bad Medicine burst, so she loses lane to range poke.

optimizer.synergy: Combustion splashes off Ricochet bounces and Bad Medicine, Noxia rewards following one ability with another, then Oblivion Crown, Crescelia, Timewarp and Wraith Leggings scale the burst.

items.Combustion: First: Pyro splash on Ricochet and Bad Medicine hits.
items.Noxia: Second: mark with Ricochet, follow with Bad Medicine for max-health damage.
items.Oblivion Crown: Third: multiplies magical power for bigger Infuse heals and burst.
items.Crescelia: Empowered basic after abilities and extra lane gold.
items.Timewarp: Shorter cooldowns for more Ricochet stuns and Infuse heals.
items.Wraith Leggings: Last: bonus magical damage on every ability.

optimizer.holes: No defense at all, so a dived Zinx dies fast unless Neural Regenesis is kept for herself.
